scene: The projector beam reveals three waiting transit stations suspended along the roof.
picture: Side-view pixel art along the rooftop. Far left, an illuminated revolving glass lift rests open. The Pacific Islander girl stands left-centre beside the projector, holding her popcorn bag and sketchbook. Centre, a brass clockwork carousel train waits on rooftop tracks. Far right, a sleek glass pneumatic tube pod sits open at its silver launch chute.
